verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י הָעָם֙ כְּמִתְאֹ֣נְנִ֔ים רַ֖ע בְּאָזְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ וַיִּ֣חַר אַפּ֔וֹ וַתִּבְעַר־ בָּם֙ אֵ֣שׁ יְהוָ֔ה וַתֹּ֖אכַל בִּקְצֵ֥ה הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hā·‘ām kə·miṯ·’ō·nə·nîm ra‘ bə·’ā·zə·nê Yah·weh way·yiš·ma‘ Yah·weh way·yi·ḥar ’ap·pōw wat·tiḇ·‘ar- bām ’êš Yah·weh wat·tō·ḵal biq·ṣêh ham·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: Soon the people began to complain about their hardship in the hearing of the LORD and when He heard them His anger was kindled and fire from the LORD blazed among them and consumed the outskirts of the camp
verses.literalPt: E ACONTECEU que, queixou-se o povo falando o que era mal aos ouvidos do SENHOR; e ouvindo o SENHOR a sua ira se acendeu; e o fogo do SENHOR ardeu entre eles e consumiu os que estavam na última parte do arraial.

verses.original: וַיִּצְעַ֥ק הָעָ֖ם אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֤ל מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וַתִּשְׁקַ֖ע הָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·‘aq hā·‘ām ’el- mō·šeh way·yiṯ·pal·lêl mō·šeh ’el- Yah·weh wat·tiš·qa‘ hā·’êš
verses.literal: And the people cried out to Moses and he prayed to the LORD and the fire died down
verses.literalPt: Então o povo clamou a Moisés, e Moisés orou ao SENHOR, e o fogo se apagou.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֛א שֵֽׁם־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא תַּבְעֵרָ֑ה כִּֽי־ בָעֲרָ֥ה בָ֖ם אֵ֥שׁ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā šêm- ham·mā·qō·wm ha·hū taḇ·‘ê·rāh kî- ḇā·‘ă·rāh ḇām ’êš Yah·weh
verses.literal: So that place was called . . . Taberah because the fire of the LORD had burned among them
verses.literalPt: Pelo que chamou aquele lugar Taberá, porquanto o fogo do SENHOR se acendera entre eles.

verses.original: וְהָֽאסַפְסֻף֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ הִתְאַוּ֖וּ תַּאֲוָ֑ה וַיָּשֻׁ֣בוּ וַיִּבְכּ֗וּ גַּ֚ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מִ֥י יַאֲכִלֵ֖נוּ בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·sap̄·sup̄ ’ă·šer bə·qir·bōw hiṯ·’aw·wū ta·’ă·wāh way·yā·šu·ḇū way·yiḇ·kū gam bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mə·rū mî ya·’ă·ḵi·lê·nū bā·śār
verses.literal: Meanwhile, the rabble among them had a strong craving for other food . . . and again the Israelites . . . wept and said Who will feed us meat
verses.literalPt: E o vulgo, que estava no meio deles, veio a ter grande desejo; pelo que os filhos de Israel tornaram a chorar, e disseram: Quem nos dará carne a comer?

verses.original: זָכַ֙רְנוּ֙ אֶת־ הַדָּגָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ נֹאכַ֥ל בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם חִנָּ֑ם אֵ֣ת הַקִּשֻּׁאִ֗ים וְאֵת֙ הָֽאֲבַטִּחִ֔ים וְאֶת־ הֶחָצִ֥יר וְאֶת־ הַבְּצָלִ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַשּׁוּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: zā·ḵar·nū ’eṯ- had·dā·ḡāh ’ă·šer- nō·ḵal bə·miṣ·ra·yim ḥin·nām ’êṯ haq·qiš·šu·’îm wə·’êṯ hā·’ă·ḇaṭ·ṭi·ḥîm wə·’eṯ- he·ḥā·ṣîr wə·’eṯ- hab·bə·ṣā·lîm wə·’eṯ- haš·šū·mîm
verses.literal: We remember the fish we ate freely in Egypt along with the cucumbers melons leeks onions and garlic
verses.literalPt: Lembramo-nos dos peixes que no Egito comíamos de graça; e dos pepinos, e dos melões, e dos porros, e das cebolas, e dos alhos.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֛ה נַפְשֵׁ֥נוּ יְבֵשָׁ֖ה אֵ֣ין כֹּ֑ל בִּלְתִּ֖י אֶל־ הַמָּ֥ן עֵינֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh nap̄·šê·nū yə·ḇê·šāh ’ên kōl bil·tî ’el- ham·mān ‘ê·nê·nū
verses.literal: But now our appetite is gone there is nothing . . . to see but . . . this manna
verses.literalPt: Mas agora a nossa alma se seca; coisa nenhuma há senão este maná diante dos nossos olhos.

verses.original: וְהַמָּ֕ן כִּזְרַע־ גַּ֖ד ה֑וּא וְעֵינ֖וֹ כְּעֵ֥ין הַבְּדֹֽלַח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·mān kiz·ra‘- gaḏ hū wə·‘ê·nōw kə·‘ên hab·bə·ḏō·laḥ
verses.literal: Now the manna resembled coriander . . . seed and its appearance was like that of gum resin
verses.literalPt: E era o maná como semente de coentro, e a sua cor como a cor de bdélio.

verses.original: שָׁטוּ֩ הָעָ֨ם וְלָֽקְט֜וּ וְטָחֲנ֣וּ בָרֵחַ֗יִם א֤וֹ דָכוּ֙ בַּמְּדֹכָ֔ה וּבִשְּׁלוּ֙ בַּפָּר֔וּר וְעָשׂ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ עֻג֑וֹת וְהָיָ֣ה טַעְמ֔וֹ כְּטַ֖עַם לְשַׁ֥ד הַשָּֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ṭū hā·‘ām wə·lā·qə·ṭū wə·ṭā·ḥă·nū ḇā·rê·ḥa·yim ’ōw ḏā·ḵū bam·mə·ḏō·ḵāh ū·ḇiš·šə·lū bap·pā·rūr wə·‘ā·śū ’ō·ṯōw ‘u·ḡō·wṯ wə·hā·yāh ṭa‘·mōw kə·ṭa·‘am lə·šaḏ haš·šā·men
verses.literal: The people walked around and gathered it ground it on a handmill or crushed it in a mortar then boiled it in a cooking pot or shaped it into cakes . . . It tasted . . . like pastry baked with fine oil
verses.literalPt: Espalhava-se o povo e o colhia, e em moinhos o moía, ou num gral o pisava, e em panelas o cozia, e dele fazia bolos; e o seu sabor era como o sabor de azeite fresco.

verses.original: וּבְרֶ֧דֶת הַטַּ֛ל עַל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה לָ֑יְלָה יֵרֵ֥ד הַמָּ֖ן עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·re·ḏeṯ haṭ·ṭal ‘al- ham·ma·ḥă·neh lā·yə·lāh yê·rêḏ ham·mān ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: When the dew fell on the camp at night the manna would fall with it
verses.literalPt: E, quando o orvalho descia de noite sobre o arraial, o maná descia sobre ele.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־ הָעָ֗ם בֹּכֶה֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔יו אִ֖ישׁ לְפֶ֣תַח אָהֳל֑וֹ וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ מְאֹ֔ד וּבְעֵינֵ֥י מֹשֶׁ֖ה רָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ mō·šeh ’eṯ- hā·‘ām bō·ḵeh lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯāw ’îš lə·p̄e·ṯaḥ ’ā·ho·lōw way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ Yah·weh mə·’ōḏ ū·ḇə·‘ê·nê mō·šeh rā‘
verses.literal: Then Moses heard the people of family after family weeping at the entrances to their tents and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly and Moses was also displeased . . .
verses.literalPt: Então Moisés ouviu chorar o povo pelas suas famílias, cada qual à porta da sua tenda; e a ira do SENHOR grandemente se acendeu, e pareceu mal aos olhos de Moisés.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֗ה לָמָ֤ה הֲרֵעֹ֙תָ֙ לְעַבְדֶּ֔ךָ וְלָ֛מָּה לֹא־ מָצָ֥תִי חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ לָשׂ֗וּם אֶת־ מַשָּׂ֛א כָּל־ הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה עָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- Yah·weh lā·māh hă·rê·‘ō·ṯā lə·‘aḇ·de·ḵā wə·lām·māh lō- mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā lā·śūm ’eṯ- maś·śā kāl- hā·‘ām haz·zeh ‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: So Moses . . . asked the LORD Why have You brought this trouble on Your servant Why have I not found favor in Your sight that You have laid upon me the burden of all these people
verses.literalPt: E disse Moisés ao SENHOR: Por que fizeste mal a teu servo, e por que não achei graça aos teus olhos, visto que puseste sobre mim o cargo de todo este povo?

verses.original: הֶאָנֹכִ֣י הָרִ֗יתִי אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אִם־ אָנֹכִ֖י יְלִדְתִּ֑יהוּ כִּֽי־ תֹאמַ֨ר אֵלַ֜י שָׂאֵ֣הוּ בְחֵיקֶ֗ךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשָּׂ֤א הָאֹמֵן֙ אֶת־ הַיֹּנֵ֔ק עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתָּ לַאֲבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: he·’ā·nō·ḵî hā·rî·ṯî ’êṯ kāl- hā·‘ām haz·zeh ’im- ’ā·nō·ḵî yə·liḏ·tî·hū kî- ṯō·mar ’ê·lay śā·’ê·hū ḇə·ḥê·qe·ḵā ka·’ă·šer yiś·śā hā·’ō·mên ’eṯ- hay·yō·nêq ‘al hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tā la·’ă·ḇō·ṯāw
verses.literal: Did I conceive all these . . . people Did I give them birth so that You should tell me Carry them in your bosom as a nurse carries an infant to the land that You swore to give their fathers
verses.literalPt: Concebi eu porventura todo este povo? Dei-o eu à luz? para que me dissesses: leva-o ao teu colo, como a ama leva a criança que mama, à terra que juraste a seus pais?

verses.original: מֵאַ֤יִן לִי֙ בָּשָׂ֔ר לָתֵ֖ת לְכָל־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּֽי־ יִבְכּ֤וּ עָלַי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר תְּנָה־ לָּ֥נוּ בָשָׂ֖ר וְנֹאכֵֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’a·yin lî bā·śār lā·ṯêṯ lə·ḵāl hā·‘ām haz·zeh kî- yiḇ·kū ‘ā·lay lê·mōr tə·nāh- lā·nū ḇā·śār wə·nō·ḵê·lāh
verses.literal: Where can I get meat for all these people For they keep crying out to me . . . Give us meat to eat
verses.literalPt: De onde teria eu carne para dar a todo este povo? Porquanto contra mim choram, dizendo: Dá-nos carne a comer;

verses.original: לֹֽא־ אוּכַ֤ל אָנֹכִי֙ לְבַדִּ֔י לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּ֥י כָבֵ֖ד מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ’ū·ḵal ’ā·nō·ḵî lə·ḇad·dî lā·śêṯ ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘ām haz·zeh kî ḵā·ḇêḏ mim·men·nî
verses.literal: I cannot . . . carry all these people by myself it is too burdensome for me
verses.literalPt: Eu só não posso levar a todo este povo, porque muito pesado é para mim.

verses.original: וְאִם־ כָּ֣כָה׀ אַתְּ־ עֹ֣שֶׂה לִּ֗י הָרְגֵ֤נִי נָא֙ הָרֹ֔ג אִם־ מָצָ֥אתִי חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ וְאַל־ אֶרְאֶ֖ה בְּרָעָתִֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- kā·ḵāh ’at- ‘ō·śeh lî hā·rə·ḡê·nî nā hā·rōḡ ’im- mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā wə·’al- ’er·’eh bə·rā·‘ā·ṯî
verses.literal: If this is how You are going to treat me please kill me right now if I have found favor in Your eyes and let me not see my own wretchedness
verses.literalPt: E se assim fazes comigo, mata-me, peço-te, se tenho achado graça aos teus olhos, e não me deixes ver o meu mal.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶסְפָה־ לִּ֞י שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִישׁ֮ מִזִּקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָדַ֔עְתָּ כִּי־ הֵ֛ם זִקְנֵ֥י הָעָ֖ם וְשֹׁטְרָ֑יו וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ אֹתָם֙ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְהִֽתְיַצְּב֥וּ שָׁ֖ם עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh ’es·p̄āh- lî šiḇ·‘îm ’îš miz·ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer yā·ḏa‘·tā kî- hêm ziq·nê hā·‘ām wə·šō·ṭə·rāw wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’ō·ṯām ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇū šām ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Bring Me seventy of the elders of Israel known to you . . . . . . as leaders and officers of the people Bring them to the Tent of Meeting and have them stand there with you
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Ajunta-me setenta homens dos anciãos de Israel, que sabes serem anciãos do povo e seus oficiais; e os trarás perante a tenda da congregação, e ali estejam contigo.

verses.original: וְיָרַדְתִּ֗י וְדִבַּרְתִּ֣י עִמְּךָ֮ שָׁם֒ וְאָצַלְתִּ֗י מִן־ הָר֛וּחַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָלֶ֖יךָ וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְנָשְׂא֤וּ אִתְּךָ֙ בְּמַשָּׂ֣א הָעָ֔ם וְלֹא־ תִשָּׂ֥א אַתָּ֖ה לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·raḏ·tî wə·ḏib·bar·tî ‘im·mə·ḵā šām wə·’ā·ṣal·tî min- hā·rū·aḥ ’ă·šer ‘ā·le·ḵā wə·śam·tî ‘ă·lê·hem wə·nā·śə·’ū ’it·tə·ḵā bə·maś·śā hā·‘ām wə·lō- ṯiś·śā ’at·tāh lə·ḇad·de·ḵā
verses.literal: And I will come down and speak with you there and I will take some of the Spirit that is on you and put that Spirit on them They will help you bear . . . the burden of the people so that you do not have to bear it by yourself
verses.literalPt: Então eu descerei e ali falarei contigo, e tirarei do espírito que está sobre ti, e o porei sobre eles; e contigo levarão a carga do povo, para que tu não a leves sozinho.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ הָעָ֨ם תֹּאמַ֜ר הִתְקַדְּשׁ֣וּ לְמָחָר֮ וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֣ם בָּשָׂר֒ כִּ֡י בְּכִיתֶם֩ בְּאָזְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר מִ֤י יַאֲכִלֵ֙נוּ֙ בָּשָׂ֔ר כִּי־ ט֥וֹב לָ֖נוּ בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וְנָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם בָּשָׂ֖ר וַאֲכַלְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- hā·‘ām tō·mar hiṯ·qad·də·šū lə·mā·ḥār wa·’ă·ḵal·tem bā·śār kî bə·ḵî·ṯem bə·’ā·zə·nê Yah·weh lê·mōr mî ya·’ă·ḵi·lê·nū bā·śār kî- ṭō·wḇ lā·nū bə·miṣ·rā·yim wə·nā·ṯan Yah·weh lā·ḵem bā·śār wa·’ă·ḵal·tem
verses.literal: And say to the people Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow and you will eat meat because you have cried out in the hearing of the LORD saying Who will feed us meat For we were better off in Egypt Therefore the LORD will give you meat and you will eat
verses.literalPt: E dirás ao povo: Santificai-vos para amanhã, e comereis carne; porquanto chorastes aos ouvidos do SENHOR, dizendo: Quem nos dará carne a comer? Pois íamos bem no Egito; por isso o SENHOR vos dará carne, e comereis;

verses.original: לֹ֣א י֥וֹם אֶחָ֛ד תֹּאכְל֖וּן וְלֹ֣א יוֹמָ֑יִם וְלֹ֣א׀ חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה יָמִ֗ים וְלֹא֙ עֲשָׂרָ֣ה יָמִ֔ים וְלֹ֖א עֶשְׂרִ֥ים יֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: lō yō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ tō·ḵə·lūn wə·lō yō·w·mā·yim wə·lō ḥă·miš·šāh yā·mîm wə·lō ‘ă·śā·rāh yā·mîm wə·lō ‘eś·rîm yō·wm
verses.literal: You will eat it . . . not for one or two days nor for five - or ten - or twenty days
verses.literalPt: Não comereis um dia, nem dois dias, nem cinco dias, nem dez dias, nem vinte dias;

verses.original: עַ֣ד׀ חֹ֣דֶשׁ יָמִ֗ים עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר־ יֵצֵא֙ מֵֽאַפְּכֶ֔ם וְהָיָ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם לְזָרָ֑א יַ֗עַן כִּֽי־ מְאַסְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־ יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֔ם וַתִּבְכּ֤וּ לְפָנָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֖ה יָצָ֥אנוּ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ ḥō·ḏeš yā·mîm ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- yê·ṣê mê·’ap·pə·ḵem wə·hā·yāh lā·ḵem lə·zā·rā ya·‘an kî- mə·’as·tem ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ă·šer bə·qir·bə·ḵem wat·tiḇ·kū lə·p̄ā·nāw lê·mōr lām·māh zeh yā·ṣā·nū mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: but for a whole month . . . until it comes out of your nostrils and makes you nauseous because . . . you have rejected the LORD who is among you and have cried out before Him saying Why did we ever leave Egypt
verses.literalPt: Mas um mês inteiro, até vos sair pelas narinas, até que vos enfastieis dela; porquanto rejeitastes ao SENHOR, que está no meio de vós, e chorastes diante dele, dizendo: Por que saímos do Egito?

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ מֹשֶׁה֒ שֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֙לֶף֙ רַגְלִ֔י הָעָ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְאַתָּ֣ה אָמַ֗רְתָּ בָּשָׂר֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם וְאָכְל֖וּ חֹ֥דֶשׁ יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh šêš- mê·’ō·wṯ ’e·lep̄ raḡ·lî hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî bə·qir·bōw wə·’at·tāh ’ā·mar·tā bā·śār ’et·tên lā·hem wə·’ā·ḵə·lū ḥō·ḏeš yā·mîm
verses.literal: But Moses replied Here I am among 600,000 . . . . . . men on foot yet You say I will give them meat and they will eat for a month . . .
verses.literalPt: E disse Moisés: Seiscentos mil homens de pé é este povo, no meio do qual estou; e tu tens dito: Dar-lhes-ei carne, e comerão um mês inteiro.

verses.original: הֲצֹ֧אן וּבָקָ֛ר יִשָּׁחֵ֥ט לָהֶ֖ם וּמָצָ֣א לָהֶ֑ם אִ֣ם אֶֽת־ כָּל־ דְּגֵ֥י הַיָּ֛ם יֵאָסֵ֥ף לָהֶ֖ם וּמָצָ֥א לָהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: hă·ṣōn ū·ḇā·qār yiš·šā·ḥêṭ lā·hem ū·mā·ṣā lā·hem ’im ’eṯ- kāl- də·ḡê hay·yām yê·’ā·sêp̄ lā·hem ū·mā·ṣā lā·hem
verses.literal: If all our flocks and herds were slaughtered for them would they have enough Or if all the fish in the sea were caught for them would they have enough
verses.literalPt: Degolar-se-ão para eles ovelhas e vacas que lhes bastem? Ou ajuntar-se-ão para eles todos os peixes do mar, que lhes bastem?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה הֲיַ֥ד יְהוָ֖ה תִּקְצָ֑ר עַתָּ֥ה תִרְאֶ֛ה הֲיִקְרְךָ֥ דְבָרִ֖י אִם־ לֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh hă·yaḏ Yah·weh tiq·ṣār ‘at·tāh ṯir·’eh hă·yiq·rə·ḵā ḏə·ḇā·rî ’im- lō
verses.literal: The LORD . . . answered Moses Is the LORD’s arm too short Now you will see whether or not My word will come to pass
verses.literalPt: Porém, o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Teria sido encurtada a mão do SENHOR? Agora verás se a minha palavra se há de cumprir ou não.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיְדַבֵּר֙ אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֶּאֱסֹ֞ף שִׁבְעִ֥ים אִישׁ֙ מִזִּקְנֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם וַֽיַּעֲמֵ֥ד אֹתָ֖ם סְבִיבֹ֥ת הָאֹֽהֶל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê mō·šeh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- hā·‘ām ’êṯ diḇ·rê Yah·weh way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ šiḇ·‘îm ’îš miz·ziq·nê hā·‘ām way·ya·‘ă·mêḏ ’ō·ṯām sə·ḇî·ḇōṯ hā·’ō·hel
verses.literal: So Moses went out and relayed to the people the words of the LORD and he gathered seventy . . . of the elders of the people and had them stand around the tent
verses.literalPt: E saiu Moisés, e falou as palavras do SENHOR ao povo, e ajuntou setenta homens dos anciãos do povo e os pôs ao redor da tenda.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨רֶד יְהוָ֥ה׀ בֶּעָנָן֮ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָיו֒ וַיָּ֗אצֶל מִן־ הָר֙וּחַ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֔יו וַיִּתֵּ֕ן עַל־ שִׁבְעִ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ הַזְּקֵנִ֑ים וַיְהִ֗י כְּנ֤וֹחַ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ הָר֔וּחַ וַיִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וּ וְלֹ֥א יָסָֽפוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·reḏ Yah·weh be·‘ā·nān way·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lāw way·yā·ṣel min- hā·rū·aḥ ’ă·šer ‘ā·lāw way·yit·tên ‘al- šiḇ·‘îm ’îš haz·zə·qê·nîm way·hî kə·nō·w·aḥ ‘ă·lê·hem hā·rū·aḥ way·yiṯ·nab·bə·’ū wə·lō yā·sā·p̄ū
verses.literal: Then the LORD came down in the cloud and spoke to him and He took some of the Spirit that was on Moses and placed that Spirit on the seventy . . . elders . . . As the Spirit rested on them they prophesied but they never did so again
verses.literalPt: Então o SENHOR desceu na nuvem, e lhe falou; e, tirando do espírito, que estava sobre ele, o pôs sobre aqueles setenta anciãos; e aconteceu que, quando o espírito repousou sobre eles, profetizaram; mas depois nunca mais.

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׁאֲר֣וּ שְׁנֵֽי־ אֲנָשִׁ֣ים׀ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֡ה שֵׁ֣ם הָאֶחָ֣ד׀ אֶלְדָּ֡ד וְשֵׁם֩ הַשֵּׁנִ֨י מֵידָ֜ד וַתָּ֧נַח עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם הָר֗וּחַ וְהֵ֙מָּה֙ בַּכְּתֻבִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יָצְא֖וּ הָאֹ֑הֱלָה וַיִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וּ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·šā·’ă·rū šə·nê- ’ă·nā·šîm bam·ma·ḥă·neh šêm hā·’e·ḥāḏ ’el·dāḏ wə·šêm haš·šê·nî mê·ḏāḏ wat·tā·naḥ ‘ă·lê·hem hā·rū·aḥ wə·hêm·māh bak·kə·ṯu·ḇîm wə·lō yā·ṣə·’ū hā·’ō·hĕ·lāh way·yiṯ·nab·bə·’ū bam·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: Two men however, had remained in the camp one named Eldad . . . and the other Medad and the Spirit rested on them They were among those listed but they had not gone out to the tent and they prophesied in the camp
verses.literalPt: Porém no arraial ficaram dois homens; o nome de um era Eldade, e do outro Medade; e repousou sobre eles o espírito (porquanto estavam entre os inscritos, ainda que não saíram à tenda), e profetizavam no arraial.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣רָץ הַנַּ֔עַר וַיַּגֵּ֥ד לְמֹשֶׁ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֶלְדָּ֣ד וּמֵידָ֔ד מִֽתְנַבְּאִ֖ים בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·rāṣ han·na·‘ar way·yag·gêḏ lə·mō·šeh way·yō·mar ’el·dāḏ ū·mê·ḏāḏ miṯ·nab·bə·’îm bam·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: A young man ran and reported to Moses . . . Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp
verses.literalPt: Então correu um moço e anunciou a Moisés e disse: Eldade e Medade profetizam no arraial.

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַן יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֗וּן מְשָׁרֵ֥ת מֹשֶׁ֛ה מִבְּחֻרָ֖יו וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנִ֥י מֹשֶׁ֖ה כְּלָאֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn mə·šā·rêṯ mō·šeh mib·bə·ḥu·rāw way·yō·mar ’ă·ḏō·nî mō·šeh kə·lā·’êm
verses.literal: Joshua son of Nun the attendant to Moses since youth spoke up and said Moses my lord stop them
verses.literalPt: E Josué, filho de Num, servidor de Moisés, um dos seus jovens escolhidos, respondeu e disse: Moisés, meu senhor, proíbe-lho.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה הַֽמְקַנֵּ֥א אַתָּ֖ה לִ֑י וּמִ֨י יִתֵּ֜ן כָּל־ עַ֤ם יְהוָה֙ נְבִיאִ֔ים כִּי־ יִתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ רוּח֖וֹ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw mō·šeh ham·qan·nê ’at·tāh lî ū·mî yit·tên kāl- ‘am Yah·weh nə·ḇî·’îm kî- yit·tên Yah·weh ’eṯ- rū·ḥōw ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: But Moses replied Are you jealous on my account I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets and that the LORD would place His Spirit on them
verses.literalPt: Porém, Moisés lhe disse: Tens tu ciúmes por mim? Quem dera que todo o povo do SENHOR fosse profeta, e que o SENHOR pusesse o seu espírito sobre ele!

verses.original: וַיֵּאָסֵ֥ף מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה ה֖וּא וְזִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·’ā·sêp̄ mō·šeh ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh hū wə·ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then Moses returned to the camp . . . along with the elders of Israel
verses.literalPt: Depois Moisés se recolheu ao arraial, ele e os anciãos de Israel.

verses.original: וְר֜וּחַ נָסַ֣ע׀ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה וַיָּ֣גָז שַׂלְוִים֮ מִן־ הַיָּם֒ וַיִּטֹּ֨שׁ עַל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֜ה כְּדֶ֧רֶךְ י֣וֹם כֹּ֗ה וּכְדֶ֤רֶךְ יוֹם֙ כֹּ֔ה סְבִיב֖וֹת הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וּכְאַמָּתַ֖יִם עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rū·aḥ nā·sa‘ mê·’êṯ Yah·weh way·yā·ḡāz śal·wîm min- hay·yām way·yiṭ·ṭōš ‘al- ham·ma·ḥă·neh kə·ḏe·reḵ yō·wm kōh ū·ḵə·ḏe·reḵ yō·wm kōh sə·ḇî·ḇō·wṯ ham·ma·ḥă·neh ū·ḵə·’am·mā·ṯa·yim ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Now a wind sent by the LORD came up drove in quail from the sea and brought them near the camp about two cubits above the surface of the ground for a day’s journey in every direction . . . . . . . . . around the camp
verses.literalPt: Então soprou um vento do SENHOR e trouxe codornizes do mar, e as espalhou pelo arraial quase caminho de um dia, de um lado e de outro lado, ao redor do arraial; quase dois côvados sobre a terra.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קָם הָעָ֡ם כָּל־ הַיּוֹם֩ הַה֨וּא וְכָל־ הַלַּ֜יְלָה וְכֹ֣ל׀ י֣וֹם הַֽמָּחֳרָ֗ת וַיַּֽאַסְפוּ֙ אֶת־ הַשְּׂלָ֔ו הַמַּמְעִ֕יט אָסַ֖ף עֲשָׂרָ֣ה חֳמָרִ֑ים וַיִּשְׁטְח֤וּ לָהֶם֙ שָׁט֔וֹחַ סְבִיב֖וֹת הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām hā·‘ām kāl- hay·yō·wm ha·hū wə·ḵāl hal·lay·lāh wə·ḵōl yō·wm ham·mā·ḥo·rāṯ way·ya·’as·p̄ū ’eṯ- haś·śə·lāw ham·mam·‘îṭ ’ā·sap̄ ‘ă·śā·rāh ḥo·mā·rîm way·yiš·ṭə·ḥū lā·hem šā·ṭō·w·aḥ sə·ḇî·ḇō·wṯ ham·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: All that day and night . . . and all the next day the people stayed up gathering the quail No one gathered less than ten homers and they spread them out all around the camp
verses.literalPt: Então o povo se levantou todo aquele dia e toda aquela noite, e todo o dia seguinte, e colheram as codornizes; o que menos tinha, colhera dez ômeres; e as estenderam para si ao redor do arraial.

verses.original: הַבָּשָׂ֗ר עוֹדֶ֙נּוּ֙ בֵּ֣ין שִׁנֵּיהֶ֔ם טֶ֖רֶם יִכָּרֵ֑ת וְאַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ חָרָ֣ה בָעָ֔ם וַיַּ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ בָּעָ֔ם מַכָּ֖ה רַבָּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hab·bā·śār ‘ō·w·ḏen·nū bên šin·nê·hem ṭe·rem yik·kā·rêṯ wə·’ap̄ Yah·weh ḥā·rāh ḇā·‘ām way·yaḵ Yah·weh bā·‘ām mak·kāh rab·bāh mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: But while the meat was still between their teeth before it was chewed the anger of the LORD burned against the people and the LORD struck them with a severe plague
verses.literalPt: Quando a carne estava entre os seus dentes, antes que fosse mastigada, se acendeu a ira do SENHOR contra o povo, e feriu o SENHOR o povo com uma praga mui grande.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֛א אֶת־ שֵֽׁם־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא קִבְר֣וֹת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֑ה כִּי־ שָׁם֙ קָֽבְר֔וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם הַמִּתְאַוִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- šêm- ham·mā·qō·wm ha·hū qiḇ·rō·wṯ hat·ta·’ă·wāh kî- šām qā·ḇə·rū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām ham·miṯ·’aw·wîm
verses.literal: So they called - that place Kibroth-hattaavah because there they buried the people who had craved other food
verses.literalPt: Por isso o nome daquele lugar se chamou Quibrote-Ataavá, porquanto ali enterraram o povo que teve o desejo.

verses.original: מִקִּבְר֧וֹת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֛ה נָסְע֥וּ הָעָ֖ם חֲצֵר֑וֹת וַיִּהְי֖וּ בַּחֲצֵרֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: miq·qiḇ·rō·wṯ hat·ta·’ă·wāh nā·sə·‘ū hā·‘ām ḥă·ṣê·rō·wṯ way·yih·yū ba·ḥă·ṣê·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people moved on to Hazeroth where they remained for some time . . .
verses.literalPt: De Quibrote-Ataavá caminhou o povo para Hazerote, e pararam em Hazerote.
